name: MTAC 284 192 MAX (MTAC, 192 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".678 (O89)". Marked (O89): Oehler 89 system. Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

G7 BC, printed ".339 (O89)". Marked (O89): Oehler 89 system. Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .284 (7mm), Grains 192, Minimum Required Twist *1-7", Part Number MTAC 284 192 MAX, G1 BC .678 (O89), G7 BC .339 (O89), OAL 1.714", Bullet Projection 1.201"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.201".
